coverage.note: A contiguous run is what makes `lifespan.lastEdition` exact rather than a floor: a course retired anywhere inside the window has a known last-publishing edition. `firstEdition` remains a FLOOR — a course published before 2023 reads as 2023 — which is why nothing in src/ renders it.
coverage.gap: 2022 and older are archived by NEU but are 'descriptive' fidelity (no prereqs, no attributes, and a title format the parser does not match), so scrape-catalog.js --edition refuses them. See docs/catalog-editions-design.md §4 and §8 step 11.
